- scripts/claude_session_janitor.py:106 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]

  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]

  WHY: A title such as `"PR #4729 — implement-plan issue-4723-x — phase 1/1 — review round"` could be added to `later_stages` and cause an earlier live issue-start session to be archived on the next sweep.

  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: `load_page` surfaces only a generic `ValueError` after JSON parse failures without logging the specific context.
  WHY: The pickup cannot distinguish a malformed harness wrapper, truncated page, or genuine JSON syntax error, delaying diagnosis of session-list problems in the field.
- scripts/claude_session_janitor.py:51 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: `subprocess.run(["gh", "api", path]...)` inherits the runner environment.
  WHY: Inherited environment variables may interfere with `gh` execution, cause unexpected behavior, or widen the surface for information exposure.
